name: What preparations do I need to make before kitchen tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before kitchen tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before kitchen tile installation, it's crucial to clear the work area. This includes emptying cabinets and drawers, removing any appliances like refrigerators, stoves, or dishwashers, and protecting countertops and other fixed elements from dust and debris. If old flooring needs removal, ensure it's accessible. It's also helpful to discuss any specific electrical or plumbing requirements with us beforehand if new fixtures are part of the remodel. Proper preparation helps ensure a smooth and efficient installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the kitchen of contents and appliances, protect fixed elements, and discuss any electrical/plumbing needs before tile installation.
